svg.title: Andrés Contreras Guillén: Firefly founder and Signature CTO
svg.desc: Founder and Technology Lead of Firefly Software and the Firefly Software Foundation. CTO at Signature, working on Lean Transformation. I build application frameworks and AI for banking and insurance. Official Firefly Software, Framework by Firefly, and Signature identities.

g.aria-label: and AI for banking and insurance.
